source: Decode usually advances each sequence by one new token at a time. At small batch sizes, many layer operations become matrix-vector or very small matrix-matrix shapes. The same model weights still need to participate, but there is much less work per token to amortize those reads. The growing KV cache also has to be read by attention.
zh: 解码通常一次将每个序列推进一个新标记。在小批量大小下，许多层操作变成矩阵-向量或非常小的矩阵-矩阵形状。相同的模型权重仍然需要参与，但每个代币摊销这些读取的工作量要少得多。不断增长的KV缓存也得靠attention来读取。
